name: feedlog
description: Open-source feedback & roadmap tool — feedback boards, public roadmap, AI-assisted changelog. Self-host on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or Docker.

paragraphs: Collect product feedback, run a public roadmap, and publish changelogs — from a tool you own and control.

FeedLog is a feedback-collection and product-communication hub for software teams. Users post ideas, vote, and discuss; teams triage into a roadmap and publish changelog entries when features ship. Built on Nuxt 4, it deploys to three platforms with zero vendor lock-in.
features: 🌐 Deploy anywhere. Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or Docker — pick your stack, keep your data.
🤖 AI-native, not AI-washed. Similar-idea detection and AI-assisted changelog drafting — first-class features, not bolted-on chatbots.
🎨 Modern Vue stack. Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn-vue.
🔓 MIT licensed, open core. This repository is the complete current product. Future enterprise add-ons live separately; the open-source version stays fully functional.
📦 Own your data. Postgres + blob storage (Cloudflare R2, Vercel Blob, or any S3-compatible: AWS, MinIO, Alibaba OSS).

whatItDoes.text: Collect product feedback, run a public roadmap, and publish changelogs — from a tool you own and control.

requirements.text: Self-host on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or Docker.
Neon and Supabase both enable it via their UI; on self-hosted Postgres run CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; once.
Both platforms offer a one-click deploy that forks the repo into your account and prompts for the required environment variables in the same form.
